subject: The secret feature 92% of couples skip by mistake
preview_text: You've been using SoulPlan for 3 weeks and still haven't tried this. It's the difference between good dates and unforgettable ones.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was looking at the data this morning and noticed something that made me pause. You've been opening the app, getting date ideas, maybe even planning a few. But there's a whole section you've never even tapped. And honestly? It's the part that changes everything.

Most couples get stuck in a loop. They find a few date ideas they like and just...rotate them. It feels safe. But safe is the enemy of spark. Safe is how you end up at the same restaurant every Friday, talking about the same things, wondering where the magic went. The couples who avoid that trap? They have a system. And you've been missing it.

It's the Date History tracker. Sounds simple, right? Just a log. But here's the truth: it's your secret weapon against relationship routine. Every date you log gets analyzed. The app learns what actually made you both light up versus what just...happened. It uses that to make every future suggestion 10x more 'you'. It turns random ideas into your personal love story blueprint.

Open SoulPlan right now. Tap the 'History' tab. Log your last date. Just one. Watch how the next batch of AI suggestions shifts. It becomes less about generic 'date nights' and more about building your unique collection of memories. P.S. The couples who use this feature report 3x more 'we have to do that again!' moments. Don't let your best dates be forgotten.
cta_text: Log My Last Date & Unlock Better Ideas
